"""Retire closed whole-boot health traces after verifying compact model evidence."""
from pathlib import Path
import fcntl
import hashlib
import json

B=Path('/home/yayoi/.local/state/strata-sycl/post-reboot-tuning-20261007')
F=Path('/home/yayoi/ghq/github.com/yqYo1/Strata/.worktree/sync-latest-updates-20261012/bench/results/2026-10-13-xe-b9-update')
def sha(p):
    return hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
def dump(p,x):
    p.write_text(json.dumps(x,indent=2,ensure_ascii=False)+'\n')
with (B/'owned-v0141-measurement.lock').open('a') as lock:
    fcntl.flock(lock,fcntl.LOCK_EX|fcntl.LOCK_NB)
    p=F/'closed-log-retention.json';m=json.loads(p.read_text())
    assert all(not Path(x['path']).exists() for x in m['deletions'])
    dp=F/'receipt-derivations.json';d=json.loads(dp.read_text())
    candidates=[]
    for name in ['main-current-xe-b9-provider-health-xe-startup-root-v1',
                 'main-current-xe-b9-provider-health-xe-startup-root-v2',
                 'main-current-xe-b9-provider-health-xe-model-root-v1']:
        original=B/name/'record.json';v=json.loads(original.read_text())
        assert v['active'] is False
        assert all(c['observation_complete'] and c['direct_child_reaped'] and c['session_empty']
                   and c['session_anchored'] and not c.get('cleanup') for c in v['commands'])
        entry=next(x for x in d['receipts'] if x['original_path']==str(original))
        assert sha(original)==entry['original_sha256']
        target=F/entry['public_path'];public=json.loads(target.read_text())
        assert all(public.get(k)==v.get(k) for k in ['passed','complete','active','error'])
        if name.endswith('startup-root-v1'):
            public['schema_failure_observations']={k:{'stdout_json':json.loads(v['evidence'][k]['stdout']),
                                                   'stderr':v['evidence'][k]['stderr']}
                                                  for k in ['device-list','device-selected','device-usage']}
            dump(target,public);entry['public_sha256']=sha(target)
        entry['original_retired_reason']='Full whole-boot journal and successful utility traces duplicate filtered kernel/fault gates, source/status and actual device/provider evidence. Fresh proof expires120s; no active or resume consumer remains. Future runs obtain new health.'
        candidates.append(dict(path=str(original),sha256=sha(original),bytes=original.stat().st_size,
                               reason=entry['original_retired_reason']))
    m['deletions'].extend(candidates)
    m['retargeted_consumers']='Completed health receipts are now represented by committed compact derivatives and original-hash metadata. No active run consumes old private health; future diagnostics require newly captured health. Model numerical comparison retains protocol, model/fixture pins and required input.'
    dump(p,m);dump(dp,d)
    for item in candidates:
        Path(item['path']).unlink()
    m.update(deleted_files=len(m['deletions']),deleted_logical_bytes=sum(x['bytes'] for x in m['deletions']),
             verified_absent=all(not Path(x['path']).exists() for x in m['deletions']),
             initial_budget_exception='Initial4MiB assertion exposed repeated full-boot journals in private health. Those unnecessary complete histories are retired; original result statuses unchanged.')
    paths=list(B.glob('main-current-xe-b9-*/record.json'))+list((B/'main-current-xe-b9-pristine-model-root-v1').glob('*/record.json'))
    m['necessary_private_receipts']['actual_bytes']=sum(x.stat().st_size for x in paths)
    assert m['necessary_private_receipts']['actual_bytes']<=m['necessary_private_receipts']['byte_budget']
    dump(p,m)
    print(json.dumps({k:m[k] for k in ['deleted_files','deleted_logical_bytes','verified_absent','necessary_private_receipts']}))
